title: Cartwise+ Membership Plan Switch Rules
content:
## Clauses in force

**S1.** A Cartwise+ Membership may switch only to a plan listed among its plan's permitted switch targets, and only while it is active.

**S2.** A switch to a plan with a higher period fee takes effect immediately, because the plan's timing for a higher-fee switch is immediate.

**S3.** A switch to Cartwise+ Assist Monthly or Cartwise+ Student Monthly requires that plan's eligibility proof to be accepted first.

**S4.** Priority Delivery upgrades are re-allotted only by the new plan's next period start.

## Retired clauses

The following clauses are no longer in force; each has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.

- **Retired — unused-days credit on an immediate switch.** "The unused days of the current period are credited, on the unused-days basis, at the old plan's daily rate (the fee captured for the current period divided by the days in the period, multiplied by the unused days) against the new plan's first fee, a new period starts on the switch date, and the plan-switch charge is the new period fee less that credit, rounded to the cent and never below zero." No longer in force.
- **Retired — timing of a lower-fee switch.** "A switch to a plan with an equal or lower fee takes effect, because the plan's timing for such a switch is the next renewal, at the next renewal date with no proration." No longer in force.
- **Retired — one switch per period.** "Only the plan's number of switches per period is allowed per paid period, so a switch is allowed only when the membership shows no plan-switch date or one earlier than the current period start." No longer in force.

## Clause S1 as a status table

| Membership status on the membership record | May switch? |
|---|---|
| active | yes, to a permitted target |
| trialing, past due, paused, pending cancellation, applied or canceled | no |

## Clause S2 — which way a switch faces

A switch is compared by period fee: a target plan whose period fee is higher than the current plan's is a higher-fee switch. The plan fees are those of the plan fee schedule. Hypothetical: a switch from a plan charging 9.99 to one charging 99.00 is a higher-fee switch and takes effect immediately.

superseded_clauses: A switch to a plan with an equal or lower fee takes effect, because downgrade_switch_timing is next_renewal, at the next renewal date with no proration.
Only switches_per_period switch is allowed per paid period, so a switch is allowed only when plan_switched_date is empty or earlier than current_period_start.

the unused days of the current period are credited under switch_proration_basis unused_days at the old plan's daily rate (membership_msr_current_period_charge divided by membership_msr_days_in_period, times membership_msr_unused_days) against the new plan's first fee, a new period starts on the switch date, and the plan_switch charge is the new period_fee_usd minus that credit, rounded to the cent and never below zero.
